name: duet-mcp
description: Let Claude read status, files and camera pictures from a Duet machine and, if enabled, home, start and supervise prints with safety guards.
long_description: Unofficial community project, alpha. Read-only by default. Heaters and motors are dangerous: never run unattended and keep the emergency stop within reach. Read SAFETY.md first.

duet_host.title: Duet IP address or host name

duet_password.title: Duet (DWC) password
duet_password.description: Stored by Claude Desktop, not in this bundle. Default of a Duet without password is reprap.

read_only.title: Read-only (true or false)
read_only.description: Keep true until you have read SAFETY.md. false enables homing, printing and G-code (you are asked to approve risky steps).
